title: Your Google Workspace, now in Legora
summary: Connect Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Calendar to the Legora Agent, and bring the documents, conversations, and schedules behind your legal work into Legora.
body_markdown:
Today, we’re making Google Workspace generally available in Legora, so the tools you already use every day can now support your legal work.


Legal work spans more than the documents you're reviewing. Agreements live in shared drives, important decisions are captured in email conversations, and meetings keep matters moving. That information provides essential context, but bringing it together often means searching across applications and manually moving files.


With Google Workspace connected, the Legora Agent can work directly with information across Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Calendar. Find documents, understand the correspondence behind an agreement, and manage meetings, all through the Agent.


#### **Bring your documents and conversations together**


The Agent can search Google Drive for agreements, policies, and other files, and bring them into Legora for review and analysis. Instead of downloading documents and uploading them manually, you can ask the Agent to find what you need.


But the document is often only part of the story.


Important details about an agreement may sit in the emails exchanged around it. With Gmail connected, the Agent can find relevant conversations and attachments, helping you understand what was discussed, what was agreed, and how a negotiation developed.


You can also work across both sources. Ask the Agent to find an agreement in Drive, retrieve the related correspondence in Gmail, and combine that information to work from.


#### **From understanding the work to moving it forward**


Google Workspace also extends what the Agent can help you do next.


Ask the Agent to draft an email response informed by the correspondence you've reviewed, ready for you to approve and send or save as a draft.


With Google Calendar connected, the Agent can check availability, find a suitable meeting time, and create or update events with your approval.


These capabilities bring more of the everyday work surrounding a legal matter into Legora, from finding the relevant information to coordinating the next step.


#### **Getting started with Google Workspace**


Google Workspace is available through a single connection, with administrators controlling which services are enabled for their organization.


1.


**Administrators** enable the Google Workspace integration under Settings → Features → Integrations, choosing which services to make available across Google Drive, Gmail, and Google Calendar.


2.


**Users** connect their Google account under Settings → Personal → Connectors → Google Workspace and begin working with the enabled services through the Agent.


The integration respects each user's existing Google permissions, so the Agent can only access information the user is authorized to see. Actions that send emails or change files or calendar events require user approval.


For more information on configuring the integration, visit our[Google Workspace setup guide](https://support.legora.com/integration-overview-google-drive) .
